summary: Frontend verification of Rainone site: (1) Hero CTA stability + clickability on desktop (1440x900) and mobile (390x844); (2) Menu horizontal scroller with arrows and tab reset. All 4 requested test areas PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: Hero content wrapper is still <motion.div> without any transforms - functionally OK but the <motion.div> could be simplified to a plain <div> since it no longer animates.

Console warning present: 'Please ensure that the container has a non-static position...' — comes from framer-motion useScroll on hero (ref target is a <section> with class 'relative' so should be OK; warning may originate from another motion component). Minor, non-blocking.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Hero content parallax removal verified (drift=0px on both desktop and mobile after 120px scroll). Menu horizontal scroller works: scrollWidth 12128 vs clientWidth 1304, single row (scrollHeight=257). Arrows scrollBy(±320) verified. Tab switch resets scrollLeft to 0 and swaps items. hero-order-btn click reliably scrolls to [data-testid='delivery-section'] on both viewports.
